projects.title: easytour
projects.description:
easytour is a mobile-first website widget that increases website conversions by three times. The widget uses high-quality video content to turn website visitors into qualified leads, and it operates 24/7 without any direct involvement.

Key features and benefits include:

Hands-off video production, including a video shoot, editing, and additional versions for social media and digital ad content.

Seamless lead generation through tour-scheduling and contact forms that add guest cards and tours into your Property Management System.

API integration with Entrata and Yardi to show users real-time availability and rates.

Lead source attribution and monthly reporting to view engagement and conversion results.

Improved efficiency by allowing on-site teams to dedicate more time and energy to the resident experience.
https://agencyfifty3.com/easytour/

projects.title: S&P Capital IQ Pro
projects.description: A comprehensive market intelligence platform offering extensive data on public company financials and industry insights across sectors including Financial Institutions, Insurance, Energy, Real Estate, and more. Capital IQ Pro provides information on 54+ million private companies, smart search capabilities, sustainability insights, supply chain intelligence, industry news, credit ratings, and real-time market prices.
